subject: Verify Penpot 2.13.3 plugin connection and PNG export
body: Run the deterministic Penpot export probe now against the reprovisioned @penpot/mcp@2.13.3 runtime. First verify whether a Penpot plugin instance is connected, then call export_shape for shapeId page, format png. Do not mutate the design. Return exact connection/export error if any, plus image_count, visual_source, visual_fallback_error, result_content_types, and visual_diagnostics.
